bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
origin="$(git remote get-url origin)"
case "$origin" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 54
sha="e60b2076fa5f87a58e7c7b1e3ee3706b06b1e552"
git cat-file -e "$sha:deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 55
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-ui-e60b2076"
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if test -d "$stage"; then
  test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 56
  test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 57
else
  git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
test -f "$stage/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 58
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cd "$stage"
  node --test test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/managementFee.test.mjs test/pgStarsLedger.test.mjs
else
  echo VIDEO_NODE_HOST_UNAVAILABLE
  exit 59
fi
echo VIDEO_UI_STAGED_SOURCE_TEST_PASS
echo VIDEO_STAGED_SHA="$sha"
